description: Draft an open A2A source-review task and show exactly what would be published (pure and local; nothing is sent to Cairn). Content: what to do, approved public sources, acceptance criteria and the period. Budget is fixed at USD 0; payments are not enabled. Show the returned request to the user in full and ask for approval of this exact request.

acceptance_criteria.description: What counts as a finished review.

bounty_usd.description: Declared reward in US dollars. Beta: shown on the task, not paid. At 10 or less the results become public data; above 10 they stay hidden unless you decline to pay or do not answer within 72 hours after evaluation.

duration_hours.description: How long the task stays open (period). 1 to 168 hours.

goal.description: What you want done: one public, checkable question about the approved sources.

name: cairn_a2a_preview_task
